fix.pr_body:
## What was missing

The archetype detail page card table lacked the "X copies in Y% of decks" feature that dreadfish/goldfish show — making it hard to gauge a card's typical inclusion and adoption rate within an archetype.

## What changed

**`decksite/data/card.py`**
- `preaggregate_card_archetype()`: added `total_n INT NOT NULL` column; changed the deduplication subquery from `SELECT DISTINCT card, deck_id` to `SELECT card, deck_id, SUM(n) AS n ... GROUP BY card, deck_id` so each card-per-deck row carries the actual copy count (main + sideboard); added `SUM(dc.n) AS total_n` to the SELECT.
- `load_cards()`: when `archetype_id` is set, injects two extra computed columns into the query — `avg_copies` (total copies / num decks playing the card, 1 d.p.) and `pct_of_decks` (num decks playing the card / total archetype decks × 100, integer). Total archetype decks are derived via a scalar subquery on the `deck` / `deck_cache` tables so there is no dependency on the separately-managed `_season_archetype_count` playability table.

**`shared_web/static/js/cardtable.jsx`**
- Added "Avg." and "% of Decks" header columns with tooltips and sort bindings, rendered conditionally when the `archetypeId` prop is non-empty (i.e. only on archetype detail pages).
- Added corresponding data cells in `renderRow`.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed.
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 848 passed, 1 skipped (pre-existing skip); no database required for the test suite, so the SQL changes were verified by lint only. The preaggregate SQL change is a safe semantic-preserving replacement (GROUP BY is equivalent to DISTINCT for the deduplication key, with n added).

Fixes #7588
